description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays language families—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—arranged sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from 0 to 40 in intervals of 5. Within each family, six bars represent different models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). The IE-Indic group exhibits the highest effect values, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 30. In contrast, the Uralic group shows the lowest effects, with all bars below 5. The Semitic group displays the greatest variability, with error bars extending from about -10 to 25, indicating significant standard deviation. The IE-Germanic group shows a consistent increase in effect across configurations, while the IE-Baltic group shows a slight decline. Error bars represent standard deviation, highlighting variation within each model and language family.
